summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace types. Added Namespace.__contains__ (prefix test via ref.startswith(str(self))) and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ (node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs; inherited by _RDFNamespace) in rdflib/namespace.py. Added NamespaceMembershipTest in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership, RDFS positive/negative, RDFS plain-string and Literal negatives, and RDF positive. Tests were not run because the task forbade running repository code; changes are verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
